MetricAlarms.AlarmDescription: Triggers when EC2 instance CPU utilization exceeds 85% for 3 consecutive 5-minute periods. This threshold was chosen based on observed normal peak load of 70%. Sustained high CPU may indicate a runaway process, traffic spike, or under-provisioning.
MetricAlarms.StateReason: Threshold Not Crossed: no datapoints were greater than the threshold (85.0). The most recent datapoints: [62.3 (04/04/26 09:00:00), 58.7 (04/04/26 08:55:00), 61.1 (04/04/26 08:50:00)].

MetricAlarms.AlarmDescription: Monitors active database connection count on the production RDS PostgreSQL instance. Alert fires when connections exceed 80 for 2 consecutive 5-minute periods. Max connections for db.t3.medium is 100 — alerting at 80% capacity to allow graceful response before connection pool exhaustion.
MetricAlarms.StateReason: Threshold Not Crossed: no datapoints were greater than the threshold (80.0). The most recent datapoints: [42.0 (04/04/26 09:00:00), 38.0 (04/04/26 08:55:00)].

MetricAlarms.AlarmDescription: Custom metric tracking application-level memory usage percentage on prod-app-01, emitted by the Node.js application via CloudWatch Embedded Metrics Format. Fires when memory usage exceeds 90% for 5 consecutive 1-minute periods. Higher sensitivity (1m period) because memory leaks tend to grow slowly and early detection reduces restart disruption.

Tracks P99 API response latency emitted by the application's /metrics endpoint via CloudWatch custom metrics. Threshold of 2000ms reflects SLA commitment to customers. Fires after 3 consecutive 1-minute breaches to filter out transient spikes. Downstream of this alarm: PagerDuty integration triggers on-call rotation.
MetricAlarms.StateReason: Threshold Not Crossed: no datapoints were greater than the threshold (2000.0). The most recent datapoints: [312.5 (04/04/26 09:04:00), 298.3 (04/04/26 09:03:00), 335.1 (04/04/26 09:02:00)].
